## ⚠️ SERIAL — read this before your first edit

**#5565 is IN FLIGHT inside `packages/app-shell/src/**` right now.** Its surface is `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` plus whatever metadata-read seam it needs — most likely `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/` (where `useObjectFields` lives) and **`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`** (it may export that hook).

Other concurrent siblings, all disjoint: #4730 (`packages/i18n/src/locales/**`), #5927 (`packages/types/src/zod/**`), #5856 (`examples/schema-catalog/**` + `content/docs/plugins/**`).

## 裁决 — triage's fence, carried verbatim

Triage seat, 2026-08-24 (finding concentration round, maintainer-invoked), promoted `finding` → `pm:queue` / Task. Verbatim:

> Fence: type `RecordDetailView`'s second `confirmHandler` as the published `ConfirmationHandler` (killing the inline near-duplicate shape) + pin that both runtimes feed the dialog the same fields. ⛔ Merging the two runtimes into one is a larger refactor — out of scope; report if the typing alignment surfaces a real divergence.

So: **two deliverables, one explicit non-deliverable.**

1. `RecordDetailView`'s `confirmHandler` is declared with the inline shape `(message: string, options?: { title?: string; confirmText?: string; cancelText?: string })` instead of the published `ConfirmationHandler`. Replace the inline shape with the published type.
2. Pin that **both** runtimes feed `ActionConfirmDialog` the same fields.
3. ⛔ **Do NOT merge the two runtimes.** Consuming `useConsoleActionRuntime` from `RecordDetailView` would make both of this card's facts disappear at once, and the card says so — and it is still **out of scope**. It is a larger refactor on a file (`RecordDetailView.tsx`) with a recorded history of drifting from shared runtimes (#5610, #3320). ⛔ Not this card. ✅ If the typing alignment surfaces a **real divergence** between the two, that is exactly what triage asked you to report.

## ⛔ What is NOT reopened

The `ConfirmationHandler` **signature itself is settled** — **keep**, per the maintainer's 2026-08-22 ruling on #5205 (retain the `options` parameter, document its out-of-runner producer). ⛔ Do not propose removing `options`, do not re-argue its liveness, and ⛔ do not "simplify" the published type to match what `RecordDetailView` happens to use.

⚠️ **The reason that matters, and it is the subtle part of this card:** `options` is **live on the `ObjectView` path and inert on the `RecordDetailView` path**. `handleDeleteView` in `ObjectView.tsx` calls its handler with all three fields localized; `RecordDetailView`'s handler is passed only as `onConfirm={confirmHandler}` into the action runner, and the runner invokes it with **one** argument — the structured `confirm` arm that used to forward a bag was retired in **#4314**. So a whole-repo liveness question about `ConfirmationHandler` has **no single answer**, which is why #5205's card title read as true from one angle and false from another. ✅ Adopting the published type on the inert path is correct **precisely because** the parameter is live elsewhere: one published type, two call paths, one of which never fills the bag.

## PM mechanism assumptions — measure, do not assume

1. **The card is verified at `5da008463` and is a day old on a file that moves.** Re-derive all of it on your merge-base: both `confirmHandler` declarations, the inline shape's exact members, the `onConfirm={confirmHandler}` call site, and the runner's arity. Report any delta. ⚠️ This seat merged **#6000** into `packages/plugin-detail` today and has **#5565** live in `packages/app-shell` — assume the file has moved.
2. ⚠️ **"Structurally identical" is a claim to verify, not to assume from the card's prose.** If the published `ConfirmationHandler` is *wider* than the inline shape (extra members, a different return type, a required `options`), adopting it is not a no-op and the diff must say what changed. If it is *narrower* in any respect, ⛔ **stop and report** — that is a real divergence and triage asked for it by name.
3. **The runner's arity is the load-bearing fact for deliverable 2.** The card says the runner invokes the confirm handler with **one** argument. Verify it in the runner's own source rather than inferring it from the handler's signature — a handler that declares two parameters and is called with one is exactly the shape that looks fine at every site and is wrong.
4. ⚠️ **A type-only change is enforced only at the type boundary.** Under erasure, reverting the declaration cannot move a runtime test. ✅ Say so plainly rather than manufacturing a runtime ablation — this lane accepted exactly that honesty on #5293 today. The **type-check** leg is where the reverse verification lives; the *pin* in deliverable 2 is what protects the runtime claim.

## Verification

**Deliverable 2's pin is the one that must be able to fail.** "Both runtimes feed the dialog the same fields" is satisfiable by a test that reads neither runtime — assert the fields **arriving at `ActionConfirmDialog`** from each path, and show the assertion goes red when one runtime's field set is perturbed. ⛔ A pin that compares two type declarations to each other proves nothing about what reaches the dialog.

**Counter-probe required:** a field that legitimately differs between the paths (or, if none does, an injected one) must make the pin **red** — otherwise "the same fields" is satisfiable by both sides being empty.

Reverse-verify at the type boundary, direction predicted **before** running: restore the inline shape and show `type-check` goes **red** (or, if it stays green because the shapes are structurally identical, ⛔ **say so** — that is the honest reading, and it means the pin in deliverable 2 is carrying the entire change). Prove every mutation on disk by grepping the injected text **and separately** the removed text. Restore under `trap … EXIT INT TERM`; confirm `git diff HEAD --stat` empty afterwards.

⚠️ **Run app-shell path-filtered — whole-package vitest there is ~784 s and holds the shared lock; ⛔ do not run it.** Use `pnpm exec vitest run <paths>` from the repo root (this repo's vitest guard refuses the `--filter` forms). Gates by name with exit codes: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (⚠️ hyphenated `type-check`; echo the script name so a zero-match silent pass cannot read as green — and a first RED reading `Cannot find module @object-ui/...` is the **unbuilt-closure signature**, not a real failure: build the dependency closure and re-read), the path-filtered vitest, and eslint on changed files with the merge-base delta stated. ⚠️ This repo's eslint spelling is a plain `eslint .` per package — ⛔ do not add `--no-inline-config`; it disables legitimate inline disables and produces phantom errors (measured on #5605).

Run `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` rather than guessing whether a changeset is owed; empty frontmatter is this repo's "releases nothing" declaration. Draft PR, `Fixes #5835`. ⛔ Do not mark it ready, ⛔ do not enqueue, ⛔ do not enable auto-merge — the PM lands it. Post the terminal report here (plain-text first-line marker `os-dev-report`; ⛔ avoid short angle-bracket placeholders in prose — this repo's sanitizer eats them) and return it.
